rows.name: OpenExamPrep
rows.what: Free exam-prep site (Bayview Global LLC) with term-definition flashcard sets for licensing, certification, admissions, driving and language tests, plus an AI study assistant.
rows.countNote: Not counted: its Terms of Service forbid collecting content 'using automated means without our express written permission'. Check its figures by hand before comparing. Footer: '© 2026 OpenExamPrep. All rights reserved.'

rows.name: Crucial Exams
rows.what: Paid practice-test platform. Each exam comes with a flashcard deck alongside its questions and PBQs.
rows.countNote: Computed: the homepage lists 79 exams as '<exam> Test Prep', and 78 of them show an 'N Flashcards' line (e.g. 'CompTIA Security+ SY0-701 (V7) Test Prep … 374 Flashcards'). Their sum is 14,053. Counted on two raw fetches that matched. Pricing page: '$19.99/mo' monthly, '$189.99' lifetime. The Security+ page says 'Try a Free Test — No Signup Required' and also marks 'Premium Content'. Terms grant a licence for 'personal, non-commercial transitory viewing only'.

rows.name: CertStud
rows.what: Freemium IT-certification practice platform with practice questions, practice exams and flashcards.
rows.countNote: Quoted from its own llms.txt: '43,802+ total questions … 4,798+ flashcards, and 279+ practice exams across 91 active certifications'. Also: 'try 10 free practice questions'; plans from '$10/month billed annually'. The certifications page says 'Browse 91 certifications'. Seen on two fetches.

rows.name: AWSomecards
rows.what: Free web flashcards for AWS certifications only, with spaced repetition in the browser.
rows.countNote: Quoted from the homepage: '3,900+ cards · 11 certifications · free forever'. Seen on two fetches. No licence statement was found on the homepage. 'sourcedCards' means no per-card source was seen on the homepage.

rows.name: UniPrep2Go
rows.what: Paid Anki decks and PDFs sold through Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy, mostly finance, licensing, real estate and language/citizenship tests. Its first timed mock is free.
rows.countNote: Computed from its own /api/facts ('catalog_size': 124). The certifications and cards fields count only the 'Finance Exams' and 'Professional & Trading' categories: 60 items with a numeric card_count, summing to 2,887 + 8,274 = 11,161. Across all 124 items, the 119 numeric counts sum to 62,167, of which 47,747 are 'Language Certifications' decks, some repeated per source language (e.g. five 'IELTS / TOEFL English for … Speakers' decks of 2,504). Terms: 'personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable license'; 'You may not scrape … to create competing products'. Prices range from $4.99 to $39 ('price_range_usd').

rows.name: FlashGenius
rows.what: AI-generated certification practice questions, study guides and flashcards.
rows.countNote: Not counted. The homepage says 'Practice with AI-generated questions … for 45+ professional certifications'. No flashcard count was published. No terms page was found at /terms or /terms-of-service, so nothing further was fetched.

rows.name: HamStudy.org
rows.what: Free flashcard and quiz drilling of official radio-licence question pools (FCC amateur and commercial, Canada, Argentina, Mexico, New Zealand).
rows.countNote: Computed: the 'Choose an exam to study for' list on the homepage names 22 pools: Technician, General, Amateur Extra, 6 Argentina ENACOM, FCC Commercial Elements 1, 3, 6, 7R, 7 and 8, plus 9, 4 Canadian, Mexico FMRE and New Zealand NZART. Cards were not counted. Footer: 'copyright 2026 Signal Stuff™, All rights reserved.' The questions come from the official pools, not from an editor citing sources card by card.

rows.name: AnkiWeb shared decks
rows.what: Anki's free deck-sharing site of user uploads: many overlapping single-certification decks by different people.
rows.countNote: Not counted: robots.txt disallows '/shared/decks/' (the search listing), and AnkiWeb publishes no total. The terms grant downloaders a licence 'for personal use only, and the deck may not be redistributed … without explicit permission'. They also say: 'While we do not have the resources to manually check decks that are uploaded…'. Sample decks from the item-info endpoint (field names from AnkiWeb's own JS): 'CISSP 10k' 9,103 notes, updated 2021-04-19; 'Cisco CCNA 200-301' 884 notes, +268/-4; 'AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 2026 Complete Exam' 1,521 notes, its sharer has 9 shared items.

rows.name: GitHub flashcard repositories
rows.what: Individual open repositories of certification flashcards.
rows.countNote: From the GitHub search API, query 'certification flashcards' sorted by stars: total_count 151. The top result, Amey-Thakur/CLAUDE-CERTIFICATIONS (56 stars, MIT), describes '110 flashcards'. GoogleCloudPlatform/google-cloud-flashcards ('Anki flashcards to study and prepare Google Cloud Platform (GCP) certifications') is archived, Apache-2.0, has 6 stars and was last pushed 2019-09-26. No repository in the top 10 is a multi-certification collection of more than a few hundred cards.

rows.name: Brainscape (Certified classes)
rows.what: Proprietary flashcard app with expert-made 'Certified' classes, including professional certifications. Pro is a subscription.
rows.countNote: Not counted: robots.txt has 'User-agent: * Disallow: /' for agents not on its named list, so no page was fetched beyond robots.txt.

rows.name: Quizlet
rows.what: User-generated flashcard sets at very large scale, including many for certifications.
rows.countNote: Not counted: every request, including robots.txt, returned HTTP 403 with a 'Captcha Challenge' page. No published statistics page could be read.

rows.name: Cram.com
rows.countNote: Not counted: the homepage returned HTTP 403 ('Request blocked', CloudFront). robots.txt was readable but no statistics page was.

rows.name: Certcy
rows.what: Free IT certification flashcards app (CompTIA A+, ISC2 CC and SSCP, per a search-result title).
rows.countNote: Not counted: its terms forbid 'Use automated tools to scrape or extract content from the App'. Only the terms page was fetched.

rows.name: Vendor flashcards (ISC2, AWS Skill Builder)
rows.what: Certification bodies' own flashcards: ISC2's free form-gated interactive cards for its own exams, and AWS Skill Builder exam prep.
rows.countNote: Not counted: isc2.org returned HTTP 403 to robots.txt, so its terms could not be read. aws.amazon.com is on this repo's no-fetch list (src/no-fetch.json) because its terms forbid automated access.

claims.text: The largest openly licensed collection of certification flashcards: about 50,600 cards under CC BY-SA 4.0, across 59 decks.
claims.basis: No other open-licensed multi-certification collection was found. The GitHub API search 'certification flashcards' (151 repos) tops out at a 110-flashcard MIT repo, and Google's Apache-2.0 GCP repo is archived. AnkiWeb shared decks are personal-use only under its terms. Every counted collection is 'All rights reserved' or under a personal-use licence (OpenExamPrep, Crucial Exams, CertStud, AWSomecards (no licence stated), UniPrep2Go, HamStudy).

claims.text: Deeper decks: about 860 cards per exam, against about 180 at Crucial Exams, about 355 at AWSomecards and about 53 at CertStud.
claims.basis: Computed from the published totals: 50,600/59; 14,053/78; 3,900/11; 4,798/91. On the 14 exams that both the Primer and Crucial Exams cover, the Primer has more cards on every one. Examples: CISSP 1,390 vs 314; AZ-104 1,416 vs 165; SC-900 1,321 vs 167 (Primer figures are note counts from the repo on 2026-10-05; recompute at build).

claims.text: More cards than Crucial Exams, CertStud and AWSomecards combined (14,053 + 4,798 + 3,900 = 22,751).
claims.basis: Figures from the rows above, read on 2026-10-05.

claims.text: The only collection we found where every card cites a public source.
claims.basis: None of the counted collections' pages claimed per-card sources. Phrase it as 'we found no other', name the collections checked and date it. This is an absence claim (see research-protocol.md).

notClaims: The largest flashcard collection, or the most certification flashcards, full stop: Quizlet, Cram and Brainscape are user-generated at far larger scale and could not be counted.
The most certifications covered: CertStud covers 91 certifications, Crucial Exams 78 exams with flashcards, and UniPrep2Go sells 124 catalogue items; the Primer has 59 decks.
The largest paid or commercial collection: the numeric card counts in UniPrep2Go's catalogue alone sum to 62,167, most of them language decks.
The most cards for every certification: a single AnkiWeb deck, 'CISSP 10k', has 9,103 notes against the Primer's 1,390 CISSP cards.
The largest free collection of exam flashcards without qualification: OpenExamPrep, a free rival, could not be counted (its terms forbid automated collection) and may be close to ours.
That no one else is free and multi-certification: OpenExamPrep, AWSomecards (AWS only) and HamStudy (radio licences) are free.
Any number for Quizlet, Cram, Brainscape, ISC2 or AWS: none was read in this task.
'The best' as a bare superlative: say what is checkable instead (open licence, a cited source per card, terms taught before testing, independent audit, 15 export formats).
